hint.title: {name}: recommended radio settings (NOT VALIDATED on a real radio, docs/postes/):
hint.all_modes: Transmission allowed in all modes (the voice goes through USB).
hint.data_only: Transmission limited to data modes: {modes} (run trx-setup again after setting up the radio to open it to the other modes).
hint.windows_port: On Windows: Device Manager > Ports (COM & LPT): take the port named « Silicon Labs Dual CP2105 USB to UART Bridge: Enhanced COM Port » for CAT.
hint.yaesu_ftdx.usb_voice: SSB MOD SOURCE (and AM, FM) = REAR and REAR SELECT = USB are set on the radio
hint.yaesu_ftdx.check.1: OPERATION SETTING > GENERAL: CAT RATE = 38400 bps (same value as the baud rate below)
hint.yaesu_ftdx.check.2: OPERATION SETTING > GENERAL: CAT TIME OUT TIMER = 1000 msec; CAT RTS = ENABLE (Hamlib RTS/CTS flow control)
hint.yaesu_ftdx.check.3: CAT port = « Enhanced COM Port » (Silicon Labs CP2105); never the « Standard COM Port » for CAT
hint.yaesu_ftdx.check.4: RADIO SETTING > MODE SSB, AM, FM, PSK/DATA: RPTT SELECT = DAKY (never RTS or DTR: the radio may go into transmit when the PC starts); CW SETTING > MODE CW: PC KEYING = OFF
hint.yaesu_ftdx.check.5: RADIO SETTING > MODE SSB, AM, FM, PSK/DATA: SSB / AM / FM / DATA MOD SOURCE = REAR and REAR SELECT = USB
hint.yaesu_ftdx.check.6: RPORT GAIN (in each mode): set it with the ALC; OUT LEVEL: level of the received audio sent to USB
hint.yaesu_ftdx.check.7: VOX key off; OPERATION SETTING > GENERAL: TX TIME OUT TIMER = 3 (min), second safety in the radio
hint.yaesu_ftdx.check.8: No HF spectrum in the app with this radio (Yaesu does not send the scope data over CAT): audio spectrum only
cat.standard_warning: WARNING: this port is the « Standard COM Port » (PTT/CW through RTS/DTR): the radio does not answer CAT on it and its RTS/DTR lines may put it into transmit.

replay.warning:
Replay of a recording (app): the operator records the RECEIVED audio (2 minutes at most,
limited to the maximum transmission time) then sends it back on the air, for example to let a correspondent
hear their own modulation. REGULATIONS: retransmitting a station's signal to third parties is generally FORBIDDEN
in the amateur service; use remains your sole responsibility. Disabled by default.

transmit.tuner: Do you use the rig's built-in antenna tuner?
transmit.tuner_settings: Remotely, tuning must start by itself when transmitting on a new frequency. Set on the rig (tuner menu): {settings}. The station will check them at every connection and warn if they are wrong (it never changes them). Outside amateur bands, tuning on PTT is not guaranteed by the rig.
transmit.tuner_generic: Remotely, tuning must start by itself when transmitting on a new frequency: set the rig accordingly (on an Icom: tuning on PTT, « PTT Start », on). This model's settings are not yet known to the station: it will not be able to check them.
rig_tot.known: Rig TOT: the station will read it at each operator connection and warn if it is OFF. Set it in the rig menu (3 min recommended): it is the last safety if the station fails during a transmission.
rig_tot.unknown: IMPORTANT: set the TOT (transmit time-out timer) in your rig menu, 3 min recommended. The station cannot read it on this rig: if it is OFF and the station, the network or the PC fails during a transmission, the rig may keep transmitting until someone intervenes on site.
